about: Modwerk source-only improved-comp package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/improved-comp.

mods.title: Improved Compressor
mods.summary: THR and MUP on the COMP page read in dB: where the compressor starts at the ratio selected, and how much makeup.
mods.description: On the COMPRESSOR page THR reads the level where the compressor starts, in dBFS, and follows RAT: 8, 15 and 18 dB later at 1:8, 1:4 and 1:2 than at MAX. MUP reads the makeup gain in dB. The numbers were measured on a unit. Only the two value texts change; nothing runs on a tick or in the audio.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, by the author's automated USB test rig on 25 November 2026, from RAM in the author's combined test image IC38 with a development base and a USB test link: THR 96 reads -36dB at RAT MAX and -18dB at RAT 1:2, MUP 32 +20.6dB, stock's text in scene mode. This package has not been flashed from the site.
